pairs.target: zǎochē dào chàkǒu shí , tǎ wéi xiǎnxiē gēnzhe yìchē rén zǒujìn rǎnfáng . chēshàng yǒurén pāi tā de jiān , shuō zhǎo jiùhuò chǎngwài yán dé yán qiáng zài zǒu yíduàn .
pairs.english: At the junction, Tavi almost followed the cart's passengers into a dye works. Someone tapped his shoulder: the old freight yard edge was farther along the wall.
pairs.hanzi:
早车到岔口时，塔维险些跟着一车人走进染坊。
车上有人拍他的肩，说找旧货场外沿得沿墙再走一段。

pairs.target: tā dào le xiè , xiàqù cái kànjiàn zìjǐ xiémiàn yǐ luò shàng yìcéng xìfěn . zhèlǐ bú xiàng zuówǎn de kè bù , qiáng hòu shēng zhe rèqì , kōngqì lǐ yǒu cǎomù zhǔ guò de kǔwèi , jǐfú rǎn hǎo de bù zài gāochù fāndòng , bǎ yìtiáo xiàngzi zhēdé shí míng shí àn .
pairs.english: Thanking them, he stepped down and noticed fine dust coating his shoes. Unlike last night's landing, heat rose behind these walls, boiled plants scented the air with bitterness, and dyed cloth flapped overhead, shading the lane by turns.
pairs.hanzi: 他道了谢，下去才看见自己鞋面已落上一层细粉。这里不像昨晚的客埠，墙后升着热气，空气里有草木煮过的苦味，几幅染好的布在高处翻动，把一条巷子遮得时明时暗。

pairs.target: jiù bǎnwū méiyǒu liúxiàlái . tì tā zhǐlù de lǎorén shuō , zìjǐ bān láishí zhèlǐ jiù yǐ shì yípiàn kōngchǎng , hòulái cái fēngěi jǐjiā rǎnfáng .
pairs.english: The old plank houses hadn't survived. The old man giving directions said the area was already empty when he had moved here, later divided between dye works.
pairs.hanzi: 旧板屋没有留下来。替他指路的老人说，自己搬来时这里就已是一片空场，后来才分给几家染坊。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi náchū wū yà xìn lǐ chāoxià de wèizhì , lǎorén yáotóu , rènde huòchǎng , bú rènde nà pái línshí zhùchù . tā zhàn zài qiángjiǎo , shǒulǐ de zhǐ hūrán méiyǒu dìfāng kěyǐ tiē .
pairs.english: Tavi produced the location copied from Wuya's letter. The man shook his head: he knew the yard, not the temporary housing. Standing at the wall's foot, Tavi suddenly had nowhere to fit his paper.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维拿出乌娅信里抄下的位置，老人摇头，认得货场，不认得那排临时住处。
他站在墙脚，手里的纸忽然没有地方可以贴。

pairs.target: lǎorén què méiyǒu jiùcǐ zǒukāi , zhǐ gěi tā kàn xiàng wěi yìjiān dī wū , shuō nàbiān guǎn jiēqū jiùwù , chāi wū shí shōu guò bùshǎo zhàng hé míngcè . yǒuméiyǒu nànián dōngxī , yào wèn guǎn de rén , búshì wèn zìjǐ zhège hòulái bān lái de .
pairs.english: The man didn't simply leave; he pointed to a low building at the lane's end, where neighborhood records were kept, including ledgers and registers collected during demolition. The keeper might know about that year, not a later arrival like him.
pairs.hanzi: 老人却没有就此走开，指给他看巷尾一间低屋，说那边管街区旧物，拆屋时收过不少账和名册。有没有那年东西，要问管的人，不是问自己这个后来搬来的。

pairs.target: dī wūmén kāi zhe , yuán shěn zhèng tì yígè lái lǐng mùjià de nánrén fānpái . tǎ wéi děng tāmen shuōwán , cái wèn jiù wéixiūduì jièzhù bǎnwū de shì . tā bú rènde fú lán , yě méi tīng guò tā nàliàngchē , zhī wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu dàgài niánfèn .
pairs.english: The door was open. Auntie Yuan was finding a tag for a man collecting wooden racks. Tavi waited, then asked about repair crews lodging in plank houses. She knew neither Fulan nor his wagon, asking only for an approximate year.
pairs.hanzi: 低屋门开着，袁婶正替一个来领木架的男人翻牌。塔维等他们说完，才问旧维修队借住板屋的事。她不认得芙兰，也没听过他那辆车，只问他有没有大概年份。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhōushīfu jì de fànwéi , wū yà tí de dìèrnián chūntiān hé jiù xìn chāojiàn fēnkāi gěi tā kàn , méiyǒu shuō nǎ yìzhāng néng tì lìngwài liǎngzhāng zuòzhǔn .
pairs.english: He separately showed Master Zhou's remembered date range, Wuya's following spring, and the copied letter, without claiming one could validate the others.
pairs.hanzi: 他把周师傅记的范围、乌娅提的第二年春天和旧信抄件分开给她看，没有说哪一张能替另外两张作准。

pairs.target: yuán shěn cóng guì dǐ bānchū sāncè báo bó , xiān fān fēngpí gěi tā kàn . nà búshì zhùhù quán cè , shì dāngshí qiān rén , xúnqīn hé dàishōu xiāoxī de dēngjì , hòulái yíjiāo gěi jiēqū .
pairs.english: Yuan brought three thin volumes from the cupboard's bottom and showed their covers. Not complete resident lists, but registers of relocation, family searches and forwarded messages, later transferred to the neighborhood.
pairs.hanzi: 袁婶从柜底搬出三册薄簿，先翻封皮给他看。那不是住户全册，是当时迁人、寻亲和代收消息的登记，后来移交给街区。

pairs.target: yǒurén zhǎodào rén huì lái gōu , yǒurén cóngcǐ méi huílái xiě , kōng zhe bùnéng dàngchéng sǐ le . tā bǎ chuāng biān de zhuōzi rànggěi tā , shuō wǔfàn qián néng kàn , zhǐ cuì , bùxǔ ná shī shǒu fān .
pairs.english: Some came to mark a reunion, some never returned to write; blank spaces didn't mean death. She let him use the window table until lunch: brittle paper, no wet hands.
pairs.hanzi:
有人找到人会来勾，有人从此没回来写，空着不能当成死了。
她把窗边的桌子让给他，说午饭前能看，纸脆，不许拿湿手翻。

pairs.target: tóu yícè méiyǒu . dìèrcè fān dào yíbàn , tǎ wéi kànjiàn fú lán liǎnggè zì , shǒuzhǐ tíng zài zhǐbiān , méi gǎn yā shàngqù .
pairs.english: Nothing in the first volume. Halfway through the second, Tavi saw Fulan's name, his finger stopping at the paper's edge, afraid to press down.
pairs.hanzi: 头一册没有。第二册翻到一半，塔维看见芙兰两个字，手指停在纸边，没敢压上去。

pairs.target: nà yìháng xiě de shì xiū jià gōng , xún nánhái , yuē liǎngsānsuì , céng liúzài shàngpō línshí huòchǎng ; hòutou lìngjì , kě dài sòng dài lǐng yòutóng shàngpō , xiān liúmíng zài dàizǒu .
pairs.english: The line read: frame-repair worker, seeking a boy, about two or three, once left at the uphill temporary freight yard. Further note: willing to escort uncollected small children uphill; leave names before taking them.
pairs.hanzi: 那一行写的是修架工，寻男孩，约两三岁，曾留在上坡临时货场；后头另记，可代送待领幼童上坡，先留名再带走。

pairs.target: rìqī zài chūn mò , pángbiān yǒu gè hěn qiǎn de chā , shì huànyè shí huáguòqù de , háishì shuí lái gōuguò , tā biàn bù chū . tā jiào yuán shěn láikàn .
pairs.english: The date was late spring; beside it a faint cross. A stray mark while turning pages or somebody's check? He couldn't tell, and called Yuan.
pairs.hanzi:
日期在春末，旁边有个很浅的叉，是换页时划过去的，还是谁来勾过，他辨不出。
他叫袁婶来看。

pairs.target: tā ná yìzhāng kōng zhǐ dǎngzhù xià yìháng , zhǐ gěi tā kàn , zhēn yǐ lǐnghuí de jìhào zài páng lán , hái huì yǒu rìqī . zhège chā bú zài lán lǐ , bùnéng suàn .
pairs.english: She covered the next line with blank paper and showed him: actual reunions were marked in a side column with a date. This cross wasn't in the column and couldn't count.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿一张空纸挡住下一行，指给他看，真已领回的记号在旁栏，还会有日期。这个叉不在栏里，不能算。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , xiōngkǒu què yìzhí fājǐn . tā yuányǐwéi dào le zhèlǐ , zuì xiǎng zhīdào de huì shì tā hòulái wǎng nǎér zǒu . xiànzài kànjiàn nà xíng zì , nǎozǐlǐ què zhǐyǒu yígè niàntou : tā zài zhǎo zìjǐ de háizi , yě hái kěn tì biérén de háizi zǒu yíduànlù .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, his chest tight. He had thought he most wanted her later destination. Now, seeing the line, he had one thought: while seeking her own child, she would still walk a stretch for someone else's.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，胸口却一直发紧。他原以为到了这里，最想知道的会是她后来往哪儿走。现在看见那行字，脑子里却只有一个念头：她在找自己的孩子，也还肯替别人的孩子走一段路。

pairs.target: " zhè néng chāo ma ? " tā wèn . yuán shěn gěi tā zhǐ , ràng tā bǎ bó míng hé yèshù yíbìng jì , bié zhī liúxià zìjǐ xiǎng kàn de nà bàn xíng .
pairs.english: “May I copy this?” he asked. Yuan gave him paper, telling him to include the volume title and page number, not only the half line he wanted.
pairs.hanzi:
“这能抄吗？”他问。
袁婶给他纸，让他把簿名和页数一并记，别只留下自己想看的那半行。

pairs.target: tā kànguò chāojiàn , quèrèn méi lòu , zài ràng tā tiān yíjù , cè zhōng wèi jiàn cǐtiáo hòuxù , bù děngyú cóngwèi zhǎodào , yě bù děngyú hái huó zài zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: She checked his copy for omissions and had him add: no follow-up found here does not mean never reunited, nor still living here.
pairs.hanzi: 她看过抄件，确认没漏，再让他添一句，册中未见此条后续，不等于从未找到，也不等于还活在这里。

pairs.target: tā xiě dé hěn màn . nà jǐjù búshì tā xiǎng dàihuíqù de dáàn , què bùnéng tì fú lán bǎ kōng chù tiánchéng zìjǐ zuì pà , huò zuì pàn de yàngzi .
pairs.english: He wrote slowly. These weren't the answers he wanted to take home, but he couldn't fill Fulan's blanks with his deepest fears or hopes.
pairs.hanzi: 他写得很慢。那几句不是他想带回去的答案，却不能替芙兰把空处填成自己最怕、或最盼的样子。

pairs.target: wǔqián tā jiāng bó fàng huíqù , chūménshí , yíliàngchē zhèng bǎ jǐmíng xīn lái de gōngrén sòngdào rǎnfáng . lǐngbān xiān wèn shuí huì xiū péng , yǒurén jǔshǒu , lìng yǒurén shuō zìjǐ zhī gēnzhe gān guò . tǎ wéi zhàn zài lùbiān , tīng dé géwài qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Before noon he returned the volume. Outside, a cart delivered new workers to the dye works. Asked who could repair shelters, some raised hands, another said he had only assisted. Tavi heard especially clearly from the roadside.
pairs.hanzi: 午前他将簿放回去，出门时，一辆车正把几名新来的工人送到染坊。领班先问谁会修棚，有人举手，另有人说自己只跟着干过。塔维站在路边，听得格外清楚。

pairs.target: tā ràohuí jiù chǎngwài yán , mǎi yìwǎn miàn zuòxià . tānzhǔ wèn tā zhǎo zhe méiyǒu , tā shuō zhǎo zhe yìdiǎn . tānzhǔ biàndāng zhèhuà gòu le , gěi hòulái de kèrén xiàmiàn , méiyǒu zhuīwèn tā yìdiǎn dàodǐ shì duōshǎo .
pairs.english: Back at the old yard's edge, he sat with noodles. The vendor asked whether he'd found anything. A little, he said. The vendor accepted that, cooking for the next customer without demanding how much a little meant.
pairs.hanzi: 他绕回旧场外沿，买一碗面坐下。摊主问他找着没有，他说找着一点。摊主便当这话够了，给后来的客人下面，没有追问他一点到底是多少。

pairs.target: chī wán , tā méi zài qù wèn měi yíshànmén . yúxià de bàntiān , yán wài dī zǒuguò yíduàn , zhēnde kàndào le yúshù . zhī xià yǒu háizi tuī zhe xiǎochē pǎo , chēlǐ zuò de lìng yígè háizi bùkěn xiàlái , shuō zìjǐ hái méi dào dìfāng .
pairs.english: After eating he didn't knock at every door. In the remaining half day he walked the outer embankment and really saw elms. Children pushed a little cart beneath them; its passenger refused to get out, saying he hadn't arrived yet.
pairs.hanzi: 吃完，他没再去问每一扇门。余下的半天，沿外堤走过一段，真的看到了榆树。枝下有孩子推着小车跑，车里坐的另一个孩子不肯下来，说自己还没到地方。

pairs.target: tā xiào le yíxià , suíhòu bízi fāsuān . méiyǒu shénme hūrán huídào jìyìlǐ , yǎnqián de shēngyīn shǔyú jīntiān , zhǐ shàng de rén shǔyú tā hái bù zhīdào de guòqù .
pairs.english: He smiled, then felt tears rising. No memory suddenly returned; these sounds belonged to today, the person on paper to a past he still didn't know.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑了一下，随后鼻子发酸。没有什么忽然回到记忆里，眼前的声音属于今天，纸上的人属于他还不知道的过去。

pairs.target: huíchéng de chē láishí , tā zài yuánlái de chàkǒu děng zhe , shǒulǐ chúle chāo hǎo de nà yè , shénme dōu méiyǒu duō ná .
pairs.english: When the return cart came, he waited at the same junction, carrying nothing extra except the copied page.
pairs.hanzi: 回城的车来时，他在原来的岔口等着，手里除了抄好的那页，什么都没有多拿。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn huí kèzhàn , gūniáng wèn jīntiān hái xiū bu xiū chuāng gōu , tā shuō gōu méi huài , zìjǐ zhǐshì yǒudiǎnlèi . tā zhǐzhǐ hòuyuàn , shuō shuǐ hái rè . tǎ wéi xiè guò , bǎ xié bǎi dào chuáng xià , xiān zuò le hěn jiǔ , cái dǎkāi nà zhāng xīn zhǐ , dú dào xiū jià gōng sāngè zì .
pairs.english: Back at dusk, the girl asked about window hooks. He said it wasn't broken; he was just tired. She pointed to the yard: water still hot. He thanked her, put his shoes beneath the bed and sat a long while before opening the new paper to read: frame-repair worker.
pairs.hanzi:
傍晚回客栈，姑娘问今天还修不修窗钩，他说钩没坏，自己只是有点累。
她指指后院，说水还热。塔维谢过，把鞋摆到床下，先坐了很久，才打开那张新纸，读到修架工三个字。
